description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/audit_response_template.xlsx. This is an IRS audit response for a home office deduction. Fill in the Space_Calculations sheet with office and home square footage data for two residences (moved mid-year), and create formulas to calculate business use percentages. In the Monthly_Allocation sheet, create expense tables for both residences showing how monthly expenses were allocated. In the Annual_Summary sheet, create formulas that reference the other sheets to show the total claimed amount (~$3,600). The annual total must be between $3,550 and $3,650. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
